channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Farmacêuticas se opõem à proposta da EMS de elevar imposto de canetas emagrecedoras importadas
item.description: EMS proposed increasing import taxes on weight-loss pens from 7.2% to 15%, facing strong opposition from the pharmaceutical industry and sectoral entities. Critics argue the measure harms competition and reduces drug supply in Brazil. EMS claims to have invested over R$1 billion in domestic production of similar medications.

item.title: Ipespe/Abrapel: Flávio Bolsonaro tem 50,5% dos votos válidos no 2º turno, e Lula, 49,5%
item.description: A poll by Ipespe/Abrapel released on October 23, 2026 shows Flávio Bolsonaro leading with 50.5% of valid votes against Lula's 49.5% in the runoff. The poll excludes blank, null, and undecided votes.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro tem 52% dos votos válidos, ante 48% de Lula, diz Alfa Inteligência
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro leads the Alfa Inteligência poll with 52% of valid votes against Lula's 48% in the runoff. The advantage is within the margin of error, remaining stable compared to the previous survey.

item.title: TSE dá 24 horas para Meta e X explicarem distribuição de conteúdos políticos
item.description: The TSE demanded that Meta and X explain within 24 hours their rules for distributing political content, advertising, content removal, and AI use, as ordered by the chief election officer, Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva.

item.title: Uma campanha eleitoral em que faltou discutir tudo, da economia à democracia
item.description: The 2026 election campaign concludes with a significant lack of substantive debates on key issues such as economy, health, education, and democracy. The first round was dominated by discussions about the Supreme Court, while the second round still lacked depth in policy proposals. The Globo debate represents the final attempt at ideological confrontation before the elections.

item.title: MC Cabelinho critica Flávio: “Nunca fez besteira sem ter o pai pra limpar”
item.description: MC Cabelinho released a YouTube video criticizing Flávio Bolsonaro, questioning his political rise and R$8 million in assets, emphasizing that the senator benefited from family privileges. The singer also attacked Flávio's meritocracy discourse. Neymar responded to the criticisms by commenting on the artist's post.

item.title: Madonna compartilha post que defende voto em Lula: 'Pela democracia'
item.description: Pop star Madonna endorsed Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) for the Brazilian presidential runoff, highlighting democracy, Amazon protection, and education. Other artists like Roger Waters voiced support for Lula while criticizing Flávio Bolsonaro (PL).

item.title: Flávio propõe retomada de privatizações; Lula quer fortalecer empresas
item.description: In the Brazilian runoff election, Flávio Bolsonaro and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva present opposing government programs on the role of the state and privatizations. Lula defends strengthening public companies like Petrobras and Correios, focusing on transparency, anti-corruption efforts, and universal digital public services. Flávio proposes resuming privatizations to reduce public deficits and modernize the state apparatus.

item.title: O risco de Flávio agir como ‘playboy da Barra’ para enfrentar Lula em novo debate
item.description: The debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro featured heated exchanges, including corruption accusations and criticism over pandemic vaccine management. Flávio took an aggressive stance, comparing Lula to someone 'vaccinated,' which triggered negative reactions. The encounter underscored rising tensions ahead of the 2026 presidential race.

item.title: Amorim diz que Trump respeitará resultado das eleições se Lula vencer, apesar de preferência por Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Special advisor Celso Amorim stated that Donald Trump will respect the Brazilian election results if Lula wins, despite preferring Flávio Bolsonaro. Amorim emphasized institutional relationship between Trump and Lula but criticized Meta's interference on social media as grave. He avoided directly accusing the White House but warned about big tech companies' influence on Brazilian foreign policy.

item.title: TSE dá 24 horas para Meta e X explicarem tratamento das candidaturas de Flávio e Lula nas redes
item.description: The TSE has given Meta and X 24 hours to explain how they handled the online presence of Flávio Bolsonaro and Luiz Inácio Lula on social media, following allegations of indirect favoritism through algorithms and AI tools. Lula's coalition claims economic power abuse and misuse of communication channels, while the electoral rapporteur emphasizes that the investigation aims to verify irregularities, without confirming the validity of the accusations. Flávio Bolsonaro and his running mate must also respond within five days, facing a daily fine of R$500,000 if they fail to comply.

item.title: Como Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro chegam ao último debate das eleições
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro prepare for the final presidential debate on TV Globo, adjusting strategies after a confrontational showdown on Band. Lula focuses on proposals and controlling reactions; Flávio aims to reduce direct attacks and clarify his positions. The debate takes place at 21:20 this Friday before Sunday's vote.

item.title: Como será o debate entre Flávio e Lula na Globo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Lula (PT) debate on TV Globo this Friday, 23rd, at 9:20 PM BRT, following the national news, in a forum moderated by César Tralli. It is the last presidential debate before the runoff on October 25th.

item.title: Áudio: TSE oferece assistente virtual aos tribunais regionais para orientar eleitores
item.description: The TSE launched ChatVote, an AI-powered virtual assistant to answer electoral service questions, available on the TSE portal and the e-Título app. The tool allows voters to check information such as polling station location, voting justification, biometrics, and electoral calendar, and can be integrated into the regional courts' websites.

item.title: Irmã de Zambelli declara voto em Lula
item.description: Paula Zambelli Salgado Brasil, sister of former lawmaker Carla Zambelli, declared her vote for Lula in the runoff, emphasizing support for democracy, the Constitution, and the rule of law, contrasting her stance with her family's alignment with the PL party.

item.title: Ministro do TSE manda Meta revisar retirada de vídeo de MC Cabelinho contra Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: TSE minister Ricardo Villas Boas Cueva ordered Meta to review the removal of an MC Cabelinho video criticizing Flávio Bolsonaro, suspecting AI bias. Lula's campaign requested an investigation into alleged unequal platform treatment, while Meta defended the takedown based on electoral rules for AI-generated content in the runoff.

item.title: Corregedor do TSE manda Meta e X explicarem tratamentos a candidaturas
item.description: The electoral court clerk ordered Meta and X to provide technical clarifications on content treatment involving candidate campaigns, including distribution and post removal, in an electoral lawsuit filed by Lula's campaign against Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Eliminação do Flamengo na Libertadores bate recorde de renda no Brasil
item.description: The match between Flamengo and Estudiantes in the Libertadores semifinal generated R$13,149,278, setting the highest revenue record for a single football match in Brazil in 2026. Played at Maracanã Stadium, the game ended with Flamengo's elimination on penalties after a goalless draw. The Rio de Janeiro club leads 8 of the top 10 revenues in Brazilian football this year.

item.title: Bella Campos apoia post de MC Cabelinho sobre eleições e anima fãs do ex-casal: 'Cura'
item.description: Bella Campos shared stories supporting MC Cabelinho during a post about elections, delighting fans of the former couple. The actress referenced the song 'Minha cura' and sparked humorous and emotional reactions from followers.

item.title: Trump respeitará eleição no Brasil, mesmo se Lula for eleito, diz Amorim
item.description: Celso Amorim states that Donald Trump will respect the outcome of the Brazilian elections, even if Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva wins the runoff. He notes that Trump already wished him luck, though he has preferences. Amorim also criticizes Meta's interference in the elections, deeming it serious.

item.title: Flávio reúne sertanejos no programa eleitoral e critica governo por dívidas das famílias, e Lula usa Janones e ataca rival sobre programas sociais
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro closes his campaign with support from country music artists, criticism of the Lula government, and a call to vote, emphasizing economy and security. Lula uses the final broadcast to attack his rival and highlight social programs, ending with a farewell and urging turnout until Sunday.

item.title: Do segundo turno ao dia seguinte: as estratégias das campanhas e os desafios de quem vencer
item.description: The campaigns of Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) adopt different strategies in the second round: Lula focuses on street mobilization and social media to expand his appeal, while Flávio maintains a cautious approach to minimize risks. Both face post-election challenges, particularly in the economic realm, with fiscal adjustments and policy prioritization.

item.title: TSE cobra Meta e X a explicarem uso de IA e alegação da campanha de Lula de benefício a Flávio nas redes
item.description: The TSE ordered Meta and X to provide clarifications about AI usage and allegations of favoritism toward Flávio Bolsonaro on social platforms. Lula's campaign claims unequal treatment in content distribution, moderation, and political content generation. Minister Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva requested detailed technical reports on the platforms' tools.

item.title: Confira a agenda dos presidenciáveis nesta sexta-feira (23)
item.description: Presidential candidates Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) participate in the final televised debate before the runoff at TV Globo, scheduled for 21:20 on Friday night (23). Neither candidate has public engagements during the day and travel to Rio de Janeiro for the debate.

item.title: Nikolas Ferreira usa novamente música de Rubel após retirada de áudio de vídeo
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) reused the song 'Grão de Areia' by Rubel in an Instagram post, following the platform's removal of audio from another video where he discussed the cost of living in northeastern Brazil. The new post features a supporter at a pro-Flávio Bolsonaro rally in Recife, holding a sign praising Nikolas. The controversy sparked mutual accusations involving Rubel, who supports Lula, and Sony Music Brasil, raising issues over copyright rights.

item.title: Debate da Globo: regras, horário e checagem do último embate entre Lula e Flávio
item.description: Globo hosts the final 2026 presidential debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro on Friday (10/23) at 9:20 PM BRT, streamed live after the nightly news. Moderated by César Tralli, the format includes four themed Q&A rounds and one open-topic segment. The BBC News Brasil will provide live coverage and fact-checking of candidate statements.

item.title: PT já enviou R$ 124 milhões para a campanha de Lula, quase o dobro do que Flávio recebeu do PL
item.description: The PT sent R$8.7 million to Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's campaign, totaling R$124.1 million since the start of the electoral period, representing 98% of the campaign's revenues. The content is exclusive for subscribers.

item.title: Sem citar Flávio Bolsonaro, 47 bispos católicos divulgam carta sobre 2º turno e criticam 'políticas de devastação que caracterizaram o Governo de seu pai'
item.description: 47 Catholic bishops from 19 Brazilian states released a letter regarding the 2026 runoff election, criticizing policies that threaten Church social doctrine and democracy, without naming the candidates Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula directly. The document highlights concerns about gun access and comparisons to authoritarian experiences of the 20th century.

item.title: Flávio libera abertura de sigilo após PT e cobra cartão corporativo de Lula
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro authorized the opening of secrecy after the PT delivered to the TSE the powers that allow bank and phone secrecy breaks, also demanding Lula's corporate card. The two campaigns have not yet officially opened their secrets.

item.title: Lula diante do maior desafio de sua vida
item.description: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva achieved an unprecedented path in Brazilian history, becoming the only union leader to found a political party and be elected president three times, including after being convicted and imprisoned for corruption. His life and career defy traditional political odds in Brazil.

item.title: Times de Brasil e Argentina farão final valendo hegemonia na Libertadores
item.description: The 2026 Libertadores final will be contested between Estudiantes (Argentina) and Palmeiras (Brazil) in a heated battle for continental supremacy, with both nations tied at 25 titles each. The match, on November 28 at the Centenario Stadium in Montevideo, will also determine which country has the most titles in the competition's history.

item.title: Lula x Flávio Bolsonaro: o que vai decidir a eleição mais acirrada da história - O Assunto #1831
item.description: The 2026 election between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro remains tied after the first round, with polls suggesting a slight numerical edge for PL but a narrowing gap. The TV Globo debate will be pivotal for swaying undecided voters amid street protests and social media battles.

item.title: Lula comenta em post de Richarlison e cita “calote da ilha”
item.description: President Lula commented on Richarlison's post about the 2026 elections, referencing the 'island scam' and urging votes for PT. The athlete's publication addressed the importance of voting without directly naming the candidates, but generated symbolic association with Lula's supporters.

item.title: Campanha deixa de lado temas essenciais ao país
item.description: As the election campaign nears its end, candidates and strategists have omitted essential issues such as the pension crisis, fiscal adjustment, and concrete measures against organized crime. Both Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) prioritized personal attacks over substantive proposals, leaving voters without clear guidelines for the next government. The absence of these debates weakens the quality of the democratic choice.

item.title: Risco de contestação a resultado não vem apenas da direita
item.description: Brazil remains deeply divided between supporters of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, with tight 2026 elections ahead. Any victory will be contested, worsening social fragmentation. The post-election challenge will be rebuilding national unity and restoring democratic coexistence.

item.title: Lula tem 50,6% contra 49,4% de Flávio em votos válidos, diz Vox
item.description: A Vox Brasil poll released on October 22, 2026 shows Lula with 50.6% against Flávio Bolsonaro's 49,4 in the second round. The margin of error is 2.15 points with 95% confidence, based on 2,100 respondents.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro tem 47,1% de rejeição e Lula, 44,8%, diz Vox Brasil
item.description: A Vox Brasil poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading rejection rates at 47.1%, followed by President Lula (PT) at 44.8%. Conducted between October 20-22, the survey polled 2,100 voters with a ±2.15 percentage point margin of error and 95% confidence level. Respondents were asked which candidate they would not vote for under any circumstances.

item.title: Vox Brasil: Lula tem 50,6% dos votos válidos; Flávio Bolsonaro, 49,4%
item.description: Vox Brasil poll shows technical tie between Lula (50.6%) and Flávio Bolsonaro (49.4%) ahead of Sunday's presidential runoff, with a margin of error of 2.15 points. The race remains tight with elections just two days away.

item.title: Vox: Lula soma 50,6% dos votos válidos, contra 49,4% de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Vox poll released on 10/22 shows Lula with 50.6% of valid votes against 49.4% for Flávio Bolsonaro in the runoff. The tie is within the technical error margin of 2.15 percentage points. The survey interviewed 2,100 voters from October 20-22, with 95% confidence.

item.title: O doador da campanha do PL que une Flávio Bolsonaro, Kassio e Roberta Luchsinger
item.description: A R$1 million donation to PL candidate Flávio Bolsonaro exposed connections between him, the TSE president Kassio Nunes Marques, lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger and lawyer Otto Medeiros, who is also linked to investigations into the medicinal cannabis trade.

item.title: Lula tem 50,6% dos votos válidos contra 49,4% de Flávio Bolsonaro, diz pesquisa Vox Brasil
item.description: Vox Brasil poll shows Lula with 50.6% of valid votes against 49.4% for Flávio Bolsonaro in the second-round race. The 1.1-point gap is within the margin of error, with Lula at 45.4% and Flávio at 44.3% in the estimated scenario. Lula leads in the spontaneous poll and has lower rejection, while government approval rises slightly.

item.title: Entre o PIX de R$ 1 e as grandes doações: o que mudou no financiamento das campanhas presidenciais de 2022 a 2026
item.description: TSE data reveals distinct funding models between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the 2026 elections: while Flávio relies on few donors with high donations, Lula expanded its contributor base and reduced resource concentration among major donors. Flávio's campaign follows a pattern opposite to Jair Bolsonaro in 2022, prioritizing significant corporate and individual donations over small collective contributions.

item.title: 34% dos doadores da campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro financiaram também Jair em 2022; Lula teve 1,4% de recorrência nas duas eleições
item.description: A g1 survey reveals that 34% of Flávio Bolsonaro's donors also funded Jair Bolsonaro in 2022, while Lula retained only 1.4% of recurring donors. Most of Flávio's recurring donors are businesspeople linked to agribusiness, with donations exceeding R$100,000. Lula's donors are connected to the government, with smaller contributions ranging from R$1,000 to R$27,000.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro é orientado a baixar o tom, e Lula, a evitar provocações no debate da Globo
item.description: The campaigns of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro adjust strategies for the Globo debate after criticism of the first confrontation; Flávio should reduce confrontations and prioritize proposals, while Lula avoids provocations. Polls show an increase in undecided voters.

item.title: Como será o debate presidencial da Globo? Entenda as regras
item.description: The presidential debate on TV Globo between Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula will take place on Friday, October 23, at 9:20 PM, live from the Globo Studios. The format includes four Q&A blocks focusing on government plans, with real-time fact-checking by Fato ou Fake. The full content will be available on Globoplay and g1 after the event.

item.title: Debate presidencial da Globo: quando será e onde assistir
item.description: The TV Globo presidential debate between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) will take place on Friday, October 23, at 9:20 PM BRT, after the Nightly News, at Globo Studios in Rio de Janeiro. The debate will be broadcast live on TV Globo, GloboNews, and g1, moderated by journalist César Tralli. Prior to the debate, each candidate will be interviewed individually by journalist Renata Lo Prete.

item.title: A última pesquisa Quaest para presidente antes do segundo turno entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The latest Quaest poll before the runoff between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro shows a technical tie, with 46% for Lula and 47% for Flávio. The margin of error is two percentage points, based on 3,702 in-person interviews. The race reflects responses to statements about Bolsa Família and street mobilizations.

item.title: TSE reúne representantes de redes sociais após Nunes Marques ordenar pente-fino em canal de apoio a Lula
item.description: The TSE will meet on Friday with representatives from digital platforms, including Meta, Google, and X, to align actions for the second round of elections following Minister Kássio Nunes Marques' order to investigate the 'Exército do Lula' channel for suspected coordinated content amplification. The measure responds to Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, which accuses the channel of artificially boosting pro-Lula messages. The closed-door meeting will include ministers specialized in electoral advertising.

item.title: Vai chover no dia da eleição? Veja a previsão para todas as regiões do Brasil
item.description: In the 2026 runoff elections, weather conditions vary significantly across Brazil's regions, with rain in the Southeast and South, and intense heat in the North, Northeast, and Center-West. The forecast indicates instability risks in the Center-West, with possible irregular rain showers, while capitals like Palmas and Manaus may reach high temperatures of up to 39 °C.

item.title: Lula e Flávio encerram campanha com agendas em São Paulo, Minas e Rio, que concentram 40% do eleitorado
item.description: Lula and Flávio wrap up their campaigns in Brazil's three most populous states — São Paulo, Minas Gerais, and Rio de Janeiro — which together account for 39.9% of voters. Flávio leads in the Southeast (48% vs 39%), but is statistically tied nationally (45% vs 44%). Both campaigns focus on reducing voter abstention, particularly among those over 70.
